scope: All 70 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 523 grid for the 22 October 2007 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the sale date, states a total of 70 lots across four catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes every numbered lot 1-70 exactly once and reports Offered: 70. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all numbered lots 1-70 appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 70 and the secondary Offered: 70 denominator
